name: aie1903-chronological-289
notes: No future leakage: train fold uses only rows strictly before each holdout window.
Official test is 289 steps (1 day + 5 min). Day cycle is 288.
Holdouts are carved from the 1728-row train table only (no test labels).
For a 289-step window ending at index e (exclusive), history is rows [0, e-289).
Last train day (rows 1440:1728) is the natural seasonal-naive source for official test.
When fitting a 289-step holdout inside 1728 rows, the final step wraps TOD via h % 288.
